note: Give an agent each prompt (with SPEC.md), save its answer as <answers>/<id>.orrery (one file with @scene, @style and @motion) or <answers>/<id>/<id>.scene/.style/.motion, then run: orrery eval tasks.json <answers>

tasks.prompt: Two meshed spur gears with module 2mm: G1 has 36 teeth and sits at the origin, G2 has 12 teeth. Turn G1 at 30deg/s about its axis for 4 seconds.

A door named Door (800 x 2000 x 40 mm) hangs on a fixed post named Frame (60 x 2000 x 60 mm) and is hinged along its left edge. It opens from 0 to 90 degrees over 2 seconds with ease-in-out, then stays open.

checks.name: door turned 90deg about the vertical at 2s

tasks.prompt: A planar four-bar linkage in the xy plane. Ground pivots at (0, 0, 0) and (110mm, 0, 0). Crank (40mm) turns about the first pivot at 180deg/s. Coupler (120mm) joins the crank tip to the tip of Rocker (90mm), which turns about the second pivot. Use the names Crank, Coupler and Rocker and the Link shape.

checks.name: rocker keeps its length to the pivot

tasks.prompt: A slider-crank: Crank (a 50mm Link) turns about the origin at 90deg/s. A connecting rod Rod (180mm Link) joins the crank tip to Piston, a cylinder that slides along the x axis inside a fixed cylinder named Bore lying along x and centred at (200mm, 0, 0).

checks.name: piston at top dead centre at t=0
piston position when crank is at 90deg

tasks.prompt: A cart named Cart (a group with a 400 x 40 x 160 mm body and front and rear axles) has four wheels of radius 50mm hinged on the axle ends. The cart drives along +x at 500mm/s for 2 seconds and the wheels roll on a ground part named Floor without slipping.
A pendulum: a 300mm rod named Arm hangs from a fixed pivot block named Pivot and swings plus or minus 30 degrees about the z axis with a period of 2 seconds, starting at the centre.

checks.name: back to the centre at half a period

tasks.prompt: A Sun sphere at the origin; Earth starts 150mm away along +x and orbits the Sun once every 12 seconds; a Moon starts 25mm from Earth along +x and orbits Earth once every 2 seconds.

checks.name: Earth a quarter of the way round at 3s

tasks.prompt: A ball named Ball (radius 20mm) starts at rest at the origin and accelerates along +x at 200mm/s2 for 3 seconds.
A motor pulley Motor (radius 20mm) at the origin drives a drum Drum (radius 60mm) at (250mm, 0, 0) through a belt. The motor turns at 360deg/s.

checks.name: drum turns at a third of the motor speed

tasks.prompt: Create a reusable part type with a radius parameter and use it for three wheels named W1, W2 and W3 with radii 20mm, 30mm and 40mm, placed 120mm apart along x starting at the origin.
A box named Crate starts at the origin and moves along +x at 300mm/s. The camera follows it with an offset of (0, 200mm, 800mm).
A clock: a disc MinuteHub turns once per 60 seconds clockwise seen from the front (+z). A disc HourHub on the same axis turns at 1/12 of the minute hub, through a coupling.
A vertical 9:16 Instagram Reel: a gear turning at 45deg/s in the middle, and a title Text part reading "How a gear turns" that always faces the camera.
Scatter 30 small flat discs (radius 15mm) across the floor in an 800mm by 600mm area, using a fixed seed so the layout is the same every time.
A slowly spinning lighthouse lamp (a glowing sphere) at night: a sky with stars and a dark ground under it.
Three gears in a row, meshed. Define one named metal style and reuse it on all three gears, then make only the middle gear brass coloured on top of that style.
